name: Annual leave
authority: Labor Code of the Philippines (P.D. 442, as amended) art.95 Art.95(2) and Handbook ch.7 §B: service incentive leave does not reach field personnel, workers on task, contract or purely commission basis, domestic helpers, or an establishment regularly employing fewer than ten (`company.facts.small_establishment`). RA 10361 s.29: a kasambahay of one year’s service has the five days of service incentive leave too; the Labor Code art.95 exclusion of domestic workers is overtaken. DOLE Handbook on Workers’ Statutory Monetary Benefits (2023) ch.7 §D: the use and conversion “may be on a pro rata basis”, and its illustration — hired 1 January 2022, resigned 1 March 2023 — converts 5 days earned as of 31 December 2022 plus (2/12) × 5 = 0.833 for January and February 2023, 5.833 in all, unrounded. The year's five days are therefore earned by completed months of the leave year and never rounded (`COMPLETED_MONTHS`, `EXACT`); a year of whole service still holds all five from its start. Coverage (§B) checked against the Handbook: government, personal service (overtaken for the kasambahay by RA 10361 s.29, `ANNUAL_LEAVE_DOMESTIC`), managerial employees and managerial staff (`MANAGERIAL`), field personnel and the unsupervised, including those on task or contract, purely commission or fixed-amount basis (Omnibus Rules Book III Rule V s.1(d); `FIELD_PERSONNEL`, `TASK_BASIS`) — a supervised piece-rate worker (`PIECE_RATE`) is not excluded, and establishments regularly employing fewer than ten (`small_establishment`) are outside; those already enjoying the benefit or five days' vacation leave with pay hold it through the employer's own leave row, which this statutory row does not duplicate. Omnibus Rules Implementing the Labor Code Book III Rule V s.5: service incentive leave not used or exhausted at the end of the year is commutable to its money equivalent; the year-end conversion is raised by its schedule on the leave year’s last day for the unused days.

name: Maternity leave
authority: Republic Act 11210 secs. 3 and 5: a pregnant private-sector female worker receives 105 days of maternity leave with full pay for a live birth, 60 days for miscarriage or emergency termination, and an additional 15 days if qualified as a solo parent. Section 5(a) separately requires three paid SSS contributions in the twelve months before the contingency semester for the SSS cash benefit. Months since SSS registration do not establish that contribution history and do not gate this leave entitlement. The SSS advance, reimbursement and employer salary differential require separate assessment under sec. 5(c). RA 11861 secs. 15 and 20 govern the Solo Parent Identification Card; unrecorded gender is not presumed, and the fifteen solo-parent days need the birth's benefit case to prove the claim with an event-valid LGU document (payroll.benefit_cases:MATERNITY_LEAVE, qualification solo_parent_documented), not the employee's current flag. An event entered as EMERGENCY_TERMINATION receives the same 60-day branch as miscarriage under RA 11210 secs. 3 and 5 and the implementing rules; this is a distinct event kind, not inferred from a live birth.

name: Annual leave
authority: Labor Code of the Philippines (P.D. 442, as amended) art.95 Art.95(2) and Handbook ch.7 §B: service incentive leave does not reach field personnel, workers on task, contract or purely commission basis, domestic helpers, or an establishment regularly employing fewer than ten (`company.facts.small_establishment`). RA 10361 s.29: a kasambahay of one year’s service has the five days of service incentive leave too; the Labor Code art.95 exclusion of domestic workers is overtaken. DOLE Handbook on Workers’ Statutory Monetary Benefits (2023) ch.7 §D: the use and conversion “may be on a pro rata basis”, and its illustration — hired 1 January 2022, resigned 1 March 2023 — converts 5 days earned as of 31 December 2022 plus (2/12) × 5 = 0.833 for January and February 2023, 5.833 in all, unrounded. The year's five days are therefore earned by completed months of the leave year and never rounded (`COMPLETED_MONTHS`, `EXACT`); a year of whole service still holds all five from its start. Coverage (§B) checked against the Handbook: government, personal service (overtaken for the kasambahay by RA 10361 s.29, `ANNUAL_LEAVE_DOMESTIC`), managerial employees and managerial staff (`MANAGERIAL`), field personnel and the unsupervised, including those on task or contract, purely commission or fixed-amount basis (Omnibus Rules Book III Rule V s.1(d); `FIELD_PERSONNEL`, `TASK_BASIS`) — a supervised piece-rate worker (`PIECE_RATE`) is not excluded, and establishments regularly employing fewer than ten (`small_establishment`) are outside; those already enjoying the benefit or five days' vacation leave with pay hold it through the employer's own leave row, which this statutory row does not duplicate. Omnibus Rules Implementing the Labor Code Book III Rule V s.5: service incentive leave not used or exhausted at the end of the year is commutable to its money equivalent; the year-end conversion is raised by its schedule on the leave year’s last day for the unused days.

name: Maternity leave
authority: Republic Act 11210 secs. 3 and 5: a pregnant private-sector female worker receives 105 days of maternity leave with full pay for a live birth, 60 days for miscarriage or emergency termination, and an additional 15 days if qualified as a solo parent. Section 5(a) separately requires three paid SSS contributions in the twelve months before the contingency semester for the SSS cash benefit. Months since SSS registration do not establish that contribution history and do not gate this leave entitlement. The SSS advance, reimbursement and employer salary differential require separate assessment under sec. 5(c). RA 11861 secs. 15 and 20 govern the Solo Parent Identification Card; unrecorded gender is not presumed, and the fifteen solo-parent days need the birth's benefit case to prove the claim with an event-valid LGU document (payroll.benefit_cases:MATERNITY_LEAVE, qualification solo_parent_documented), not the employee's current flag. An event entered as EMERGENCY_TERMINATION receives the same 60-day branch as miscarriage under RA 11210 secs. 3 and 5 and the implementing rules; this is a distinct event kind, not inferred from a live birth.
